value.rationale: The question is the natural quantitative refinement of local finiteness: classify every finite-chain complex modal subalgebra and count how many k-tuples generate each one. The classification identifies the entire subalgebra lattice, while the exact random generation law uncovers a logarithmic typical generator requirement despite an optimal generator rank of one. The Poisson window quantifies a meaningful deterministic-versus-random separation. The ordinary single-generator witness and the binomial calculation alone are not treated as novel contributions.
